title_zh: 固定预算下的模型误差比较
title_en: Comparing Model Errors Under a Fixed Budget

sources.text: Comparing Model Errors Under a Fixed Budget
Under a fixed budget, the error fell from 12% to 9% on the held-out set. This suggests improved performance in this setting, but does not establish a universal advantage.
The comparison used the same evaluation procedure. Therefore, the result concerns this budget and dataset rather than all deployment conditions.
